name: max_parallel_workers
description: Sets the maximum number of parallel worker processes that can be active system-wide for parallel query execution and maintenance operations.
symptoms: Underutilized CPU cores during parallel queries
Parallel queries falling back to serial execution
Ineffective parallelism despite high I/O or CPU capacity
tuning_tips: Set to the number of available CPU cores (or slightly less) to balance parallelism and CPU contention; always ensure it is >= max_parallel_maintenance_workers and >= max_parallel_workers_per_gather.
